title: biosig-zarr format version 2: root group metadata document
description: The root zarr.json of a format version 2 store, transcribed from spec/index.md at release 2.0.0, which is the definition. Attributes the text lists as possibly absent in a version 2 store are not required, and unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Zarr requirements: a store MUST be a Zarr v3 hierarchy, and every node's metadata is in a zarr.json object. Root attributes: the attribute table.

zarr_format.$comment: Zarr requirements: a store MUST NOT use Zarr version 2 metadata.

node_type.$comment: Hierarchy: the root is a group.

attributes.$comment: Root attributes: the REQUIRED rows, less view_chunk_columns, which What changes the version lists as possibly absent. generated_by is REQUIRED (Proposed), but a reader MUST NOT require it until it leaves Proposed, so it is not required here.

format.$comment: Format name: the name biosig-zarr (Proposed) and the legacy name biosigio-zarr denote the same format; a reader MUST refuse a store whose format is neither name.

format_version.$comment: Format version: format_version MUST be an integer, and this page specifies version 2.

modality_rates.description: The rate caps the writer applied, in hertz, keyed by uppercase modality name.

recording_metadata.description: Format version: version 2 holds a JSON object here, where version 1 holds a string. Recording metadata: its members are not defined.

subject_info_excluded.$comment: Root attributes: CONDITIONAL, true when the exclusion ran; Status of this document: a CONDITIONAL attribute MUST be absent when its condition does not hold, so when present it is true.

channels_tsv_units.$comment: Root attributes: it holds the integer counts converted, relabelled, and kept_importer_unit, and the boolean units_column_present.

generated_by.description: Proposed. Generating software: the software that produced the store.
generated_by.$comment: Generating software: generated_by MUST be a non-empty array of objects.

generatedByEntry.$comment: Generating software: every entry MUST have name (string) and version (string).
